The '''Maximum Security Ops Center''' was the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] primary command base in the [[Maximum Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison|prison complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It was located in the northeastern corner of the Maximum Security Section, near one of the access roads to the [[High Security Section]].
